newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Swedish shares end at record high, Ericsson surges.
newsitem.headline: Swedish shares end at record high, Ericsson surges.

text.p: Swedish shares ended at record highs on Friday, fuelled by positive U.S. stock market trends.
The exchange's general index jumped 1.3 percent to a record high of 2,539.48 in turnover of 4.65 billion crowns.

The upturn was led by heavyweights drugs major Astra and telecoms group Ericsson. Astra was boosted by a strong Thursday performance by its U.S. counterparts and Ericsson was also helped by favourable sector trends.
Astra rose three crowns to 345.5, while Ericsson surged eight to 243. Drugs company Pharmacia & Upjohn was also strong, ending up five to 268.5 crowns.
"There seems to be a large interest in buying telecoms shares," a trader said.
Engineering company ABB also shone, up forty to 920 crowns.
But forestry shares underperformed the general index with the sector index up 0.11 percent after two Swedish forestry companies, Stora and SCA, presented 1996 earnings this week.
"It feels a bit early to trade in forestry shares," a dealer said. "The situation is still uncertain."
